cases.title: Stopping before a pass records a partial lesson

rubric.reason: The Turn 4 record_lesson matches the last diff_since_last: Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s were eased_by_learner, Scale and Opacity were still_linear, and passed was false. So result "partial" is supported, demo_used false matches the absence of any set_ease call, it claims no learner method, and it holds no name, email or phone number.
